Bug_Details: Object clone() should be implemented with super.clone().
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the `clone()` method of the `MyObject` class, which should have returned a shallow copy of the object using `super.clone()`, but instead it returned a new object with the same name and age as the original object.

Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by calling the clone() method on an instance of MyObject, which is a class that implements the Cloneable interface. The clone() method creates a new instance of the class, but does not copy the original object's values to the new instance. As a result, the new instance has the same reference as the original object, which causes the test case to fail.
